title: Facebook page leads to Michael Johnson

tellings.quote: a fan of the show, shout out Jason Miller, hit us up with a Facebook page, a page just sitting there, and lo and behold, it was for a 70some yearear-old Michael Johnson living in South Carolina

plain: While trying to find Air Force veterans who say they were taken by aliens about 50 years ago, Michels' team was sent a Facebook page by a fan named Jason Miller, and it belonged to a man in his seventies named Michael Johnson living in South Carolina. Michels tells this himself in the episode where the veterans meet again. In his telling, that page is how the reunion came about.
